entries.title: Native plugin workspace navigator
entries.description: The bundled T3-inspired AppKit navigator loaded through native plugin discovery and hosted in the real main-window split shell. It is the reference native-extension composition of ThreadingDesignKit pane, search, virtual table, selection, control, menu, popover, typography, spacing, and palette primitives. The evidence covers selected and lifecycle-grouped rows, project and branch metadata, and exact theme delivery without changing the default Native route; host/model tests own the interaction round-trips.

sizes: 400-point leading navigator in a 1120×720-point main window
